start: Owner signed in; the gym is online and several members have the app; the menu row 'Messages & offers'

steps.action: Open 'Messages & offers'
user_sees: Title 'Messages & offers' with 'Messages, offers and wishes for your members, in the app and on WhatsApp'
Tabs 'Messages', 'Workout offer', 'Reminders'
A picker 'Kind of message' and a row of ready messages
must_not: The page opening on 'Workout offer' for an owner

steps.action: Pick a ready message or type a 'Title' and a 'Message'; pick a 'Group'
user_sees: A preview of how it looks in the member's inbox
Letter counts for title and message
Each group named with its number of members
must_not: A title or message longer than allowed accepted without a word
A group count that differs from who gets it

steps.action: Tap 'Send in the app'
user_sees: A line such as 'Goes to <n> members in the app. Send now?' with 'Yes, send' and 'Not yet'
must_not: The message sent on the first tap with no question

steps.action: Tap 'Yes, send'
user_sees: 'Sending…', then a note 'Sent to <n> members in the app.'
A green pill 'Sent in the app' in place of the button
The message on top of 'Sent in the app' with its kind, how long ago, and how many members have seen it
must_not: The message sent twice
A member outside the group getting it
'Sent' shown when the server refused it

start: Today shows a nudge such as '3 birthdays today'

steps.action: Tap the nudge
user_sees: 'Messages & offers' opens with the birthday wish and its group already picked
must_not: An empty page to start from
The wish aimed at every member

steps.action: Tap another nudge on Today later
user_sees: The page starts again with that message picked
must_not: Words of the earlier message left in the boxes

start: Messages & offers with a message ready; some of the group do not have the app (the WhatsApp way)

steps.action: Look under 'On WhatsApp'
user_sees: Chips 'Send on WhatsApp to': 'Not in the app <n>' and 'Whole group <n>'
Button 'WhatsApp one by one (<n>)'
'Opens your own WhatsApp with the words typed in. It costs nothing.'
must_not: The button live with 0 people
A member with the app counted under 'Not in the app'

steps.action: Tap 'WhatsApp one by one (<n>)' and send to each person
user_sees: A sheet that opens the owner's own WhatsApp for one member at a time
Afterwards '<k> of <n> done on WhatsApp for this message.'
must_not: A WhatsApp sent by the app itself
Two people with one shared number both messaged when one per number was meant

start: Messages & offers; the owner wants the message to go out tomorrow morning (a timed message)

steps.action: Under 'When' pick a later time and set 'Day and time'
user_sees: The chosen day and time in words
must_not: A time in the past accepted
'Send in the app' live while the time is not valid

steps.action: Tap 'Send in the app', then 'Yes, send'
user_sees: 'Goes to every member in the app on <when>. Send then?' and then 'Goes out <when> to <n> members in the app.'
Pill 'Timed in the app'; in the list 'Goes out <when> · <n> members' with a 'Cancel' button
must_not: The message arriving on phones now
A time shown without the day

start: Messages & offers; edge cases of sending

steps.action: With no member in the app, tap 'Send in the app'
user_sees: 'No member has the app yet. Members who join in the next 14 days will see it. Send now?'
must_not: 'Goes to 0 members'
The send refused with no reason

steps.action: Pick a group in which nobody has the app
user_sees: 'Send in the app' greyed; the WhatsApp button is the main one
must_not: A message sent to nobody and listed as sent

steps.action: After the day's or week's allowance of messages is used, try another
user_sees: A line in the warning colour saying why (exact words not read); 'Send in the app' greyed
must_not: An extra message slipping through

steps.action: Tap 'Yes, send' while the internet drops
user_sees: A red message; the 'Sent in the app' list is read again so a message that did go is shown
must_not: The owner sending the same message a second time because the first looked failed

start: A message was sent in the app an hour ago; another is timed for tomorrow

steps.action: Tap 'Take back' on the sent one
user_sees: A browser question 'Take back “<title>”? It is removed from every member’s inbox.'
must_not: The message removed with no question

steps.action: Agree
user_sees: The card dims and gets a red pill 'Taken back'; no 'Take back' button any more
must_not: The message still in members' inboxes
The card gone from the list

steps.action: Tap 'Cancel' on the timed one and agree
user_sees: Red pill 'Cancelled'
must_not: The message still going out at its time
The question saying it is removed from inboxes it never reached

steps.action: Change one word of the message just sent
user_sees: The pill 'Sent in the app' goes and 'Send in the app' is back
must_not: The changed message blocked as already sent

start: Owner sending the second and third message of a day to one plan's members

steps.action: Pick the group and tap 'Send in the app'
user_sees: When the app can only send to everyone: 'Goes to all <n> members in the app, not only this group. Send now?'
Before a later message of the day: a line saying it arrives without a phone pop-up
must_not: A message for one group reaching others without the owner being told
Another member's name or amount inside a member's message

steps.action: Send and look at the list
user_sees: Pills 'To a group' and 'No phone pop-up' where they apply; '<n> members' and how many have seen it
must_not: The names of who has not read it shown as a shaming list
